notes: Every version, URL and checksum below was looked up on 2026-11-15 from the project's own release page / registry, never from memory. validate-local.ps1 downloads only the URLs below (https, host allow-list in validate-local.lib.ps1), refuses any file whose hash differs from this lock, and refuses an installed binary whose sha256 differs from exeSha256.

sha256 (binaries) = the published checksum: the GitHub release asset `digest` field of the GitHub API, cross-checked against the release checksums file where the project publishes one (see verifiedBy). exeSha256 = sha256 of the extracted executable, computed once from a download whose archive hash matched, so later runs can re-verify the installed file without re-downloading.
sha512 (PowerShell modules) = the PackageHash of the PowerShell Gallery feed (base64 SHA512), https://www.powershellgallery.com/api/v2/Packages(Id='<id>',Version='<v>').
Docker images are pinned by the digest of the multi-platform manifest list on Docker Hub; `docker run <repo>@<digest>` makes Docker verify the content against it.
Not pinned on purpose: the Trivy vulnerability database (fresh advisory data is the point; trivy downloads it from ghcr.io on first use into the tools directory).
